opportunities.title: Small Grants

amount.raw: generally £1,500-£5,000; exceptionally up to £6,000; travel up to £2,000-£2,500 per person; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. No grants to individuals for personal projects (though UK office may consider individuals with organisational backing). Applications welcome from previous recipients. UK projects apply via UK office; Japan projects via Japan office.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, exchange ideas/expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Supports festivals, events, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits across arts and culture, humanities and social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year; continuing projects up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, total limit £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally show an existing research record; consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan. Preference for those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants. Apply to the UK office regardless of location.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including the study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Creates opportunities for researchers, practitioners, policy makers, managers and voluntary sector workers to share knowledge and develop new approaches. Grants may cover travel, conference and publication costs.
